title: The Marshall Plan
subject: histoire
description: In **1947**, Europe is in ruins. The United States is offering massive aid to rebuild it… and to curb communism.

hero.hook: Thirteen billion dollars to save Europe. And, behind the scenes, to win the Cold War.

blocks.text: In June **1947**, Europe emerged from the war exhausted. Cities destroyed, factories stopped, hunger everywhere. In Washington, the American Secretary of State **George Marshall** then announced an unprecedented aid plan.
Officially, it is about rebuilding. In reality, it is also a strategy: to prevent poverty from pushing the West towards communism, facing the USSR of **Joseph Stalin**.
After **1945**, power grids and transportation are broken. The winter **1946-1947**, very harsh, made everything worse: little coal, rationing, anger in the streets.

In France, industrial production falls to around **38%** from its **1938** level. Communist parties are making progress in elections. For the United States, hunger becomes a political danger: if Europe loses its vote, Moscow wins without firing a shot.

blocks.caption: Poster of the Marshall Plan: American aid presented as a common European project.

blocks.text: To make the plan popular, the Americans organized a poster competition in Europe: more than **10,000** drawings were sent.

sections.title: The American offer, and the Soviet refusal

blocks.text: **June 5, 1947**, at Harvard University, Marshall sets a clear condition. Europeans must agree on a common plan. No aid dispersed country by country.

The offer is first open to the USSR. But Stalin refuses, and forbids Poland and Czechoslovakia to accept. Only **16 countries** in Western Europe come together in the , the organization responsible for distributing the funds. The continent is split in two. **[[OEEC]]**
Between **1948** and **1952**, the United States sends approximately **13 billion dollars** (more than today's **150 billion**). It's not mainly about tickets: machines, coal, tractors, food.

The system is simple. Europe resells these goods in local currency. The money recovered finances roads, factories, modernization. From **1952**, industrial production exceeded pre-war levels by **35%**. West Germany begins its , the “economic miracle”. [[The German Wirtschaftswunder]]
The aid roughly covered the European trade deficit: enough for Europe to continue buying American without going bankrupt.

sections.title: A political as well as economic victory

blocks.text: The plan applies : curbing Moscow with prosperity, not just with weapons. It weakens revolutionary parties, brings the United States and Europe closer together, and pushes former enemies, France and Germany, to cooperate. This habit of working together prepares the future , ancestor of the European Union. **[[The Truman Doctrine]]** **[[EEC]]**

events.title: Harvard speech
events.detail: Marshall announces the principle of coordinated aid.

events.title: Nobel Prize
events.detail: Marshall is rewarded for peace through reconstruction.

blocks.text: Between **1948** and **1952**, the Marshall Plan injected **13 billion** to rebuild Western Europe, curb communism and lay the foundations for European cooperation.
